text:
You need a mobile-first MVP website that is responsive, user-friendly, and built with a modern front-end approach that works well on cloud-hosted infrastructure.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full stack web developer with 7 years of experience, and I’d be a strong fit for this build. I work with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS, so I can take your MVP from layout and interaction through to a polished, production-ready implementation.

A relevant example is the Streaming chat widget for Quillstack, where I built the front end and Node proxy for a tutoring chat that streams answers token by token. The result was first token on screen in about 600 ms, supporting 30k chats a month. That project required careful attention to fast UI updates, responsive behavior, and a smooth user experience, which is directly useful for an MVP website that needs to feel modern on mobile.

I also built the Live fleet dashboard for Ferrylane Freight, a dispatcher map showing every truck’s position and ETA as GPS pings arrived. That interface tracked 1,800 trucks live and kept the time from ping to screen under 2 seconds. While the product is different, the core challenge was the same: create a responsive interface that updates cleanly, stays usable on smaller screens, and performs well in real time.

For your project, I can help turn the Figma design into a responsive mobile website with clean HTML/CSS, interactive JavaScript behavior, and a React-based structure if needed. I’m comfortable building with a modern component approach and can work with the requirements of a cloud-hosted deployment environment as the project evolves.

If you’d like, I can review the Figma file, outline the implementation approach, and get started building the MVP experience with a strong focus on mobile usability and visual polish.
